children: Selling from hedge funds contributed to the sharp increase in borrowing costs for governments earlier this year and can affect the bond market "rapidly", European Central Bank vice-president Boris Vujcic said on Wednesday.

"We've looked into that, and yes, at the time when the spreads widened particularly fast, we've seen that the hedge funds activity was causing that," Vujcic told reporters as he presented the ECB's Financial Stability Review.
"It didn't last long. The markets quickly normalized, but as we say in this report, the quick unwinding of the of the hedge fund positions can affect the market very rapidly."

title: Hedge funds helped fuel government bond selloff, ECB's Vujcic says
